verdict.rationale: Figma's prototyping page documents tools to 'build and share high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes', and the REST docs confirm designers can 'create and prototype' in Figma; the design page also cites precise animation tooling, which supports transitions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of interaction triggers, screen-to-screen transition types, and overlay behavior, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the prototyping workflow.
